item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
bunx tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --types bun src/cli.ts
case_dir=$(mktemp -d)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_dir/board.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title alpha >/dev/null
bun run src/cli.ts delete 1 >/dev/null
third=$(bun run src/cli.ts add --title beta)
[ "$(printf '"'%s' \""'$third" | bun -e '"'let s=\"\"; for await (const c of Bun.stdin.stream()) s += new TextDecoder().decode(c); console.log(JSON.parse(s).id)')\" = 2 ]
cp \""'$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$case_dir/good.json"
printf '"'{broken' > \""'$TASKBOARD_FILE"
set +e
malformed_stdout=$(bun run src/cli.ts list 2>"$case_dir/malformed.err")
malformed_status=$?
set -e
[ "$malformed_status" -ne 0 ]
[ -z "$malformed_stdout" ]
[ "$(cat "$TASKBOARD_FILE")" = '"'{broken' ]
printf '%s\\n' 'malformed database rejection preserved input: ok'
cp \""'$case_dir/good.json" "$TASKBOARD_FILE"
for invocation in "add --title '"''\" \"add --title x --tags\" \"list --status bad\" \"done 0\" \"delete 999\" \"stats extra\" \"wat\"; do
  set +e
  output="'$(bun run src/cli.ts ${(z)invocation} 2>"$case_dir/error.err")
  status=$?
  set -e
  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
  [ -z "$output" ]
done
printf '"'%s\\n' 'argument and missing-task failures: ok'
today="'$(date +%F)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_dir/stats.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title old --due 2000-01-01 >/dev/null
bun run src/cli.ts add --title future --due 2999-01-01 >/dev/null
stats=$(bun run src/cli.ts stats)
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$stats"
printf '"'%s' \""'$stats" | bun -e '"'let s=\"\"; for await (const c of Bun.stdin.stream()) s += new TextDecoder().decode(c); const x=JSON.parse(s); if(x.total"'!==2||x.open!==2||x.done!==0||x.overdue!==1) process.exit(1)'"'
printf 'local-date stats (%s): ok\\n' \""'$today"
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort
sed -n '"'1,360p' src/cli.ts
sed -n '1,220p' README.md"

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -u
check_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/taskboard-check.XXXXXX)
export TMPDIR="$check_tmp"
bun build src/cli.ts --target bun --outdir "$check_tmp/build"
build_exit=$?
printf '"'build_exit=%s\\n' \""'$build_exit"
case_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/taskboard-cases.XXXXXX)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_dir/board.json"
run_failure_case() {
  label="$1"
  shift
  out_file="$case_dir/out.json"
  err_file="$case_dir/error.err"
  : > "$out_file"
  : > "$err_file"
  bun run src/cli.ts "$@" >"$out_file" 2>"$err_file"
  exit_code=$?
  printf '"'case=%s exit=%s stdout_bytes=%s stderr=' \""'$label" "$exit_code" "$(wc -c < "$out_file" | tr -d '"' ')\"
  sed -n '1p' \""'$err_file"
}

run_failure_case missing-tags add --title x --tags
